title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #7 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #7 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. According to Genesis 1:27, human beings were created in the what of God? (1 mark)
   A. Name only
   B. Image
   C. Voice only
   D. Shadow

2. Which of these shows respect for the differences among people? (1 mark)
   A. Giving people nicknames about their bodies
   B. Laughing at how others speak
   C. Leaving out children who look different
   D. Playing with children from different backgrounds

3. What should you do before the day ends if you have quarrelled with a friend? (1 mark)
   A. Plan revenge
   B. Make peace and forgive
   C. Stop speaking to them
   D. Tell others lies about them

4. According to Philippians 4:8, what should Christians think about? (1 mark)
   A. Whatever hurts others
   B. Whatever is true, pure and lovely
   C. Whatever is unkind
   D. Whatever is false

5. You find a Ksh 100 note in the classroom. What is the right choice? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it quietly
   B. Give it to the teacher to find the owner
   C. Spend it at the school shop
   D. Hide it

6. What should you do if you make a wrong choice? (1 mark)
   A. Hide it
   B. Admit it, say sorry and try to put it right
   C. Repeat it
   D. Blame others

7. What brings harmony in a family? (1 mark)
   A. Jealousy
   B. Respect and love among members
   C. Selfishness
   D. Fighting

8. Which of these is a way of respecting family members at home? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting at siblings
   B. Refusing to share
   C. Ignoring instructions
   D. Greeting politely and helping with chores

9. Why should Christians respect their bodies? (1 mark)
   A. Because it is fashionable
   B. The body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
   C. Because of money
   D. Because they are proud

10. Which parts of the body are private? (1 mark)
   A. The face
   B. The parts covered by underwear or a swimming costume
   C. The hands
   D. The feet

11. What does it mean to say that the Bible is inspired? (1 mark)
   A. It was written in one day
   B. People invented it
   C. The writers copied other books
   D. God guided the writers so that their message is His word

12. Which book comes directly after Genesis? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus
   B. Joshua
   C. Numbers
   D. Leviticus

13. Which of these is an honest use of money? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in a game
   B. Stealing from a friend
   C. Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   D. Lying about the price

14. What did God first tell Balaam about going with Balak's messengers? (1 mark)
   A. Do not go with them
   B. Take a gift
   C. Curse Israel
   D. Go at once

15. What did the donkey say to Balaam? (1 mark)
   A. What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?
   B. Please go home
   C. I am tired
   D. Give me water

16. What did Samson's set-apart life to God mean he must never do? (1 mark)
   A. Visit his parents
   B. Go to Timnah
   C. Eat honey
   D. Cut his hair

17. What animal attacked Samson near Timnah? (1 mark)
   A. A wolf
   B. A young lion
   C. A snake
   D. A bear

18. Why is Joseph a good example of leadership? (1 mark)
   A. He was rude
   B. He was honest, wise and hardworking
   C. He was lazy
   D. He was selfish

19. Where was Joseph when the cupbearer remembered him? (1 mark)
   A. In his father's house
   B. In Canaan
   C. In prison
   D. In the palace

20. How old was Abram when he left Haran? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 100
   C. 75
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give three ways of showing respect to family members. (3 marks)

22. Give two reasons why Zacchaeus climbed the sycamore-fig tree. (2 marks)

23. Why did King Balak ask Balaam for help? (2 marks)

24. Explain the meaning of the word "inspired" when we say the Bible is inspired by God. (3 marks)

25. Explain how to find Luke 19:1-10 in the Bible. (4 marks)

26. Give three ways of obeying God in daily life. (3 marks)

27. Explain how Proverbs 1:7 helps us to understand why Joseph was so wise. (5 marks)

28. Give two words that describe Joseph's character in this story. (2 marks)

29. Write the first three books of the New Testament in order. (2 marks)

30. State four ways of looking after your body as God's special creation. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #7 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Image
   Genesis 1:27 says that God created human beings in His own image.

2. D — Playing with children from different backgrounds
   Respecting differences shows that we value all of God's creation.

3. B — Make peace and forgive
   Ephesians 4:26 says not to let the sun go down on your anger.

4. B — Whatever is true, pure and lovely
   Philippians 4:8 lists true, noble, right, pure and lovely things.

5. B — Give it to the teacher to find the owner
   Honesty means returning what is not ours.

6. B — Admit it, say sorry and try to put it right
   Being honest about mistakes lets us make things right.

7. B — Respect and love among members
   Respect and love make a home peaceful.

8. D — Greeting politely and helping with chores
   Polite words and helpful actions build peace at home.

9. B — The body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
   1 Corinthians 6:19 gives this reason.

10. B — The parts covered by underwear or a swimming costume
   Private parts are those covered by underwear.

11. D — God guided the writers so that their message is His word
   2 Timothy 3:16 teaches that Scripture is inspired by God.

12. A — Exodus
   The order is Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy.

13. C — Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   Honesty means returning what is not ours.

14. A — Do not go with them
   God told him not to go and not to curse the people.

15. A — What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?
   Numbers 22:28 records the donkey's question.

16. D — Cut his hair
   A Nazirite did not cut his hair.

17. B — A young lion
   Judges 14:5 says a young lion came roaring towards him.

18. B — He was honest, wise and hardworking
   These qualities helped him to lead Egypt well.

19. C — In prison
   Joseph was in prison in Egypt.

20. C — 75
   Genesis 12:4 says he was seventy-five.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Greet politely, obey, help with chores, speak kindly, share, pray for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 3.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: He was short, the crowd was big, and he wanted to see Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: He was afraid of the Israelites and wanted them to be cursed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fear and 1 mark for wanting the Israelites cursed.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Inspired means that God guided the people who wrote the books. What they wrote is His message to people, so the Bible is God's word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God guiding the writers, 1 for the message being God's, 1 for the conclusion that the Bible is God's word.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Use the contents page to find the book of Luke. Turn to chapter 19. Then find verses 1 to 10 within that chapter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for finding the book, 1 for the chapter, 1 for the verses, 1 for using the contents page.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Obey parents and teachers, read and follow the Bible, tell the truth, pray, be kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: The fear of the Lord means respect and love for God. Joseph respected God, trusted Him and obeyed Him. God gave him wisdom, so he could interpret the dream and give good advice. We too should respect God to receive wisdom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning of the verse, 1 for Joseph respecting God, 1 for God giving wisdom, 1 for the good advice, 1 for application to us.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wise, honest, humble, faithful, hardworking, trusting in God. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid word.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Matthew, Mark, Luke.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two correct in order, 2 marks for all three correct.

30. (4 marks)
   Answer: Eat healthy food, keep clean, rest and exercise, avoid harmful things such as drugs, do not hurt yourself or others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.
